notes: HR and admins can now handle an absent employee the same way a manager can. Open Today's attendance, pick the Absent tab, and anyone who has not checked in and is not on leave has a “Mark leave” action — choose Paid, Unpaid or Emergency, add a reason, and the day is recorded properly instead of sitting as an unexplained absence. It is filed as a real leave request approved by you, so the balance, the attendance record and the employee's notification all happen exactly as they would for a request the employee filed themselves. Paid leave draws their 2-days-a-month paid quota and anything past it becomes loss of pay; the confirmation tells you which it was. You can only do this for employees in the companies you manage, and never for yourself. The same screen now warns you when people are missing: once the late cut-off has passed, a banner lists who has not checked in and is not on leave. Before the cut-off it stays quiet, because people simply have not arrived yet. You can also pick an earlier date to review a past day, and see how many arrived late and by how much. Also in this build, from 2.8.8: managers get the same absent-employee tools on My Team; signing back in remembers your employee code and password from the phone's secure keystore; attendance regularization can carry a monthly limit; and selecting a date or switching tabs no longer nudges anything on screen.
